title: Update URL when selecting List in the sidebar
description: Selecting List in the project sidebar changes the visible page but leaves the URL at /<project-id>. The URL must become /<project-id>/list immediately.
why: Shareable and direct routes must match the visible view so refresh, back/forward, and copied links work predictably.

steps: Click List in the project sidebar
repro.expected: The URL becomes /<project-id>/list while the ticket list is shown.
repro.actual: The list is shown, but the URL stays at /<project-id>.

outcome.summary: Sidebar List now delegates to the list-view helper with forceList enabled, updating the URL to /<project-id>/list on desktop and mobile.
outcome.verifiedBy: npm run check passed (123 passed, 1 optional real-model test skipped); UI test asserts sidebar List wiring and the shared list helper updates route history.
